headline_counts.label: CRM skills across the Sales and Customer Service plugins
ERP skills in the Dynamics 365 ERP apps plugin (coming in phase 2)

skills.name: Pipeline prioritizer
skills.what: Ranks open opportunities by value, urgency, risk and momentum, with the reason to work each one next.
skills.prompt: Review my open opportunities for this week and give me a ranked worklist with the evidence and next action for each.

skills.name: Deal rescue
skills.what: Investigates a stalled or at-risk opportunity and recommends how to get it moving.
skills.prompt: The Fabrikam renewal has gone quiet for three weeks. Find out why it stalled and what I should do next.
skills.note: Named by Microsoft on Oct 8, 2026; not yet in the Learn skills table.

skills.name: Customer engagement strategy
skills.what: Builds a 30-day plan for who to engage at an account, why they matter and how to reach them.
skills.prompt: Build a 30-day engagement strategy for Fabrikam around their expansion project. Who should I meet, in what order, and why?

skills.name: Meeting preparation
skills.what: Pulls account, opportunity and activity context together before a customer meeting.
skills.prompt: Prepare me for tomorrow's meeting with Fabrikam: who is attending, what changed and what they will ask.

skills.name: Post-meeting follow-up
skills.what: Captures decisions, owners and dates, proposes record updates and drafts the customer follow-up for review.
skills.prompt: After today's Fabrikam meeting, capture decisions and owners, propose record changes and draft a follow-up for my review.

skills.name: Deal catch-up
skills.what: Shows what changed across deals since a date you choose, separating customer movement from record housekeeping.
skills.prompt: What changed across my active deals since last Monday? Separate customer movement from CRM updates.

skills.name: Competitive strategy
skills.what: Tailors positioning and objection responses to a deal using approved competitor evidence.
skills.prompt: Help me position against our main competitor on the Fabrikam deal. Flag any claim that needs checking.

skills.name: Business case composer
skills.what: Builds a decision-ready business case from the customer's own evidence and flags missing inputs.
skills.prompt: Draft a business case for Fabrikam's expansion using what they told us, and list what we still need from them.

skills.name: Deal desk
skills.what: Gets support, guidance and escalation for complex or at-risk opportunities, including product and pricing configuration.
skills.prompt: Prepare a deal desk request for Fabrikam: the configuration they want, the discount asked and the approvals needed.

skills.name: Stage advance readiness
skills.what: Checks a deal against your stage criteria. It assesses readiness; it does not move the stage.
skills.prompt: Is the Fabrikam opportunity ready to move to Propose? Show what is confirmed and what is missing.

skills.name: Reconcile my opportunity
skills.what: Compares recent customer conversations with the opportunity record and proposes field updates for you to approve.
skills.prompt: Compare my last three Fabrikam emails and meetings with the opportunity and propose any field updates.

skills.name: Draft outreach
skills.what: Writes personalized customer emails and outreach for review.
skills.prompt: Draft a short note to Fabrikam's new finance director introducing our team and suggesting a call.

skills.name: CRM data hygiene
skills.what: Finds and fixes data quality issues in your CRM records.
skills.prompt: Find my opportunities with missing close dates, stale stages or no next step, and propose fixes.

skills.name: Sales Research Agent
skills.what: Researches accounts, competitors and market trends, including pipeline and forecast analysis.
skills.prompt: Why did our win rate in the mid-market segment drop this quarter?

skills.name: Segment analysis
skills.what: Analyzes customer segments to find patterns and opportunities.
skills.prompt: Which customer segments grew fastest this year, and where are we under-covered?

skills.name: Executive deal review
skills.what: Prepares an executive summary of critical deals and pipeline status.
skills.prompt: Prepare a one-page review of our top ten deals for Thursday's leadership meeting.

skills.name: Forecast rollup
skills.what: Consolidates and checks forecast numbers across the team.
skills.prompt: Roll up my team's forecast for the quarter and flag deals where the forecast and the evidence disagree.

skills.name: Team pipeline review
skills.what: Analyzes team pipeline health, velocity and forecast accuracy.
skills.prompt: How healthy is my team's pipeline for next quarter? Show coverage, velocity and the biggest gaps.

skills.name: Team activity coaching
skills.what: Reviews team activity and suggests coaching on the work, not the person.
skills.prompt: Which of my team's deals have gone without customer contact for two weeks, and what coaching would help?

skills.name: Case triage
skills.what: Orders open cases by deadline, customer impact, commitments and unanswered messages, with the reasons.
skills.prompt: Review my escalated cases and give me a prioritized worklist with the reasons for the order.

skills.name: Case preparation brief
skills.what: Summarizes one case before the next interaction: status, history, what was tried and open commitments.
skills.prompt: Give me a one-screen brief on case 12345: customer, product, history and prior cases.

skills.name: Answer research
skills.what: Researches a source-backed answer from verified knowledge and similar cases, and flags conflicting or thin evidence.
skills.prompt: Find the answer to this customer's warranty question from our knowledge articles and similar cases, with sources.

skills.name: Draft customer reply
skills.what: Drafts a reply grounded in verified case facts and policy, and leaves it as a draft for review.
skills.prompt: Draft my reply to the customer on case 12345 using the matching knowledge article. Leave it for my review.

skills.name: Knowledge harvest
skills.what: Turns a verified fix into reusable guidance with customer details removed, and checks for duplicate articles.
skills.prompt: Turn the fix on case 12345 into a draft knowledge article: symptom, cause, workaround and verified fix.

skills.name: Customer brief and value metrics
skills.what: Brings unified customer context and KPIs into a sales or service conversation.
skills.prompt: Give me a customer brief for Fabrikam with their open cases, satisfaction trend and contract value.
skills.note: Named by Microsoft on Oct 8, 2026; works across sales and service.
